senses.definition_en: Of, resembling, or pertaining to, Dragon Ball; Dragon Ball-esque.

examples.english: Actually, it wasn't a joke, I get that this is the most snobbish thing we have seen in Dragon Ball, and due to what was known of him, I took the typical unblemished god of American comics tailored to youngsters (Marvel, DC) as "the gag", but Dragon Ball-esque, (I love the design, eh), what we was known of him, or what looked like they were trying to sell to us (or I misunderstood it, now I see that I did), the greatest exemplar in the said American comics, which are "the presence" and "The One Above All" but for DBSuper.
examples.ref: 2016 November 23, Eonkun, “DRAGON BALL SUPER: Serie de TV secuela de Z creada por Toriyama (SPOILERS)”, in El Otro Lado, archived from the original on 17 Apr 2025:
examples.text: Realmente no era broma, entiendo que es lo más cheto que hemos visto en dragon ball, y por lo que teniamos sabido de él, me lo tomaba como "el gag" al tipico dios intachable de los comics americanos destinados a jovenzuelos (marvel, dc), pero en versión dragonbolesca (que el diseño me ecanta^([sic – meaning encanta]) eh), lo que se sabía de él, o lo que parecia que nos querian vender (o yo mal interprete, que ya veo que si), al máximo exponente en dichos comics americanos, que son "la presencia" y "The One Above All" pero para DBSuper.
examples.translation: Actually, it wasn't a joke, I get that this is the most snobbish thing we have seen in Dragon Ball, and due to what was known of him, I took the typical unblemished god of American comics tailored to youngsters (Marvel, DC) as "the gag", but Dragon Ball-esque, (I love the design, eh), what we was known of him, or what looked like they were trying to sell to us (or I misunderstood it, now I see that I did), the greatest exemplar in the said American comics, which are "the presence" and "The One Above All" but for DBSuper.

examples.english: As they say: buckle up, because we'll be getting tons of Dragon Ball-esque fanservice!
examples.ref: 2018 June 25, “Dragon Ball Heroes: Revelada la sinopsis del primer episodio del anime”, in Atomix.vg, archived from the original on 17 Apr 2025:
examples.text: ¡Como quien dice agárrense, que se nos viene muchísimo fanservice Dragonbolesco!
examples.translation: As they say: buckle up, because we'll be getting tons of Dragon Ball-esque fanservice!

examples.english: Even though many knew that Dragon Ball-esque fact, it's very likely other Dragon Ball followers didn't know it at all, as there are tons of anecdotes and curious facts surrounding Dragon Ball that it's common some are overlooked.
examples.ref: 2020 July 20, José Carlos Pozo, “La inspiración de Akira Toriyama para diseñar los scouters de Dragon Ball Z”, in Hobby Consolas, archived from the original on 17 Apr 2025:
examples.text: Aunque seguramente muchos ya conocían este "dato dragonbolesco", es muy probable que otros tantos seguidores de Dragon Ball lo desconocieran por completo, pues son tantas las anécdotas y curiosidades de Dragon Ball que es normal que algunas de ellas se pasen por alto.
examples.translation: Even though many knew that Dragon Ball-esque fact, it's very likely other Dragon Ball followers didn't know it at all, as there are tons of anecdotes and curious facts surrounding Dragon Ball that it's common some are overlooked.

glosses: Of, resembling, or pertaining to, Dragon Ball; Dragon Ball-esque.
